title: Queen Slime takes flight: hops in phase one, flies and slams in phase two
player_outcome: Queen Slime hops and bombards you with crystals. At half life she spreads her wings, flies above you raining gel bolts, and crashes down in screen-shaking slams.
design: Data only on top of P4-02.
queen_slime phase 1: ground; hop ×3; wait with a crystal ring volley; summon crystal_slime (plus bouncy_slime and heavenly_slime if they exist, else add them as gel variants).

Phase 2 (below 0.5): fly true, model queen_slime_winged, moves [hover height 8 with a queen_slime_gel spread volley 90 ticks, slam speed 26 telegraph 30 with a crystal ring volley on impact] ×2 then a dash.
New hostile projectile queen_slime_gel (pink orb, gravity 4, bounces 1).
files_modify: data/enemies/hallow_ocean.json — queen_slime pattern, projectile, slime variants
tests: BossTests.QueenSlimeTakesWingAtHalfLife: UsesGravityFor is false and she holds a height ≥ 5 m above the target.
risks: Flying slams in narrow terrain may bury her. Slam ends on OnGround or Ticks, and teleport stays in the loop.
